hook.title: It works on *localhost*. Deploy failed *six* times.

beats.text: It works on localhost. Six failed deploys. Demo's in two hours.
Another redeploy won't help. Localhost isn't the real test.
You sent six screenshots. One was lunch.
The lunch one was an accident.
Step one. Paste the full build log as text.

panel.title: Paste the full log
panel.html:
here is the full log, as text
Error: Command failed: npm run build (line 312)
Line 312 is the real one.

beats.text: It's four hundred lines. Half of it is dots.
Good. The dots aren't the problem. Line 312 is.
Step two. Run Claude Code and point it at the log.

panel.title: Let Claude read it
panel.html:
~/nia-demo $ claude
Reading build-log.txt and .env...
Cause: API_URL is set on your laptop, not the server.

beats.text: It's probably the env file. I never touch that.
Git says you edited it at one a.m. Twice.
Step three. Before any change, ask it to explain the cause.

panel.title: Explain before changing
panel.html:
Explain the cause. Change no files yet.
Cause: API_URL missing on the serverWould edit: 1 file
No edits yet

beats.text: Just fix it. I have a demo.
Two hours is exactly why I explain first.
beats.say: Two hours is exactly why I explain first.

beats.text: The server has no API_URL. Your laptop does.
beats.say: The server has no A P I URL. Your laptop does.

beats.text: Wait. Localhost never runs the real build?
Localhost runs the dev server. The deploy runs the build.
Step four. Run the build here. Fix it until it passes.

panel.title: Build it here first
panel.html:
~/nia-demo $ npm run build
✓ built. API_URL added on the host.
Deploy once. Not six times.

beats.text: I was about to deploy it again. Blind.
Seven would have been your record. Nobody wants that.
It's live! Two hours to spare. I'm adding a chart.
Fine. When it breaks, paste the error. As text.
